_README: HANDOVER TEMPLATE -- fill in and send back.
One file, 8 cells: 4 emotions x 2 shapes, holding the aggregated final values
rather than individual samples. Check it before sending with:
Exit code 0 means it is safe to build against. Non-zero prints exactly what is
wrong and where. No API key, no network, nothing leaves your machine.
The 'variables' block below is the contract, and cells are checked against it.
Change the contract and the cells together and the file stays self-consistent, so
nothing here has to wait on the repo being updated first.
Updated for: saturation as a percentage from two bands, and warm-white lighting.
notes: Aggregated from the consistency batch. Method and N per cell below.

_comment: enum              -- value must be one of 'values'
bands             -- value must fall inside one of 'bands'
per_emotion_bands -- range depends on the cell's emotion; null declares that
emotion exploratory, so any positive value passes and is
reported as 'no locked range' rather than as a failure.
Mark a variable "optional": true while it is still being decided and it may be
left out of cells. Adding a variable here is all that is needed to add one.

saturation_pct._comment: Per your note: a specific percentage per cell, from one of two bands. Maps directly onto HSV saturation, so 15% becomes 0.15 in the material system.

material._comment: Roughness. Keep as-is if material stays one variable.

material_type._comment: Only if you split material into roughness plus a type. Marked optional so the file validates either way. Placeholder values -- see my note on which ones stay orthogonal to the hue manipulation. Delete this whole entry if material stays one variable.

_comment: All four null pending your finalised illuminance ranges. The earlier
45-150 / 670-780 figures have been REMOVED at your request (1 Aug: those were
exploratory, from the generation tests Daniele and Eyal suggested, not the
literature intended for the final ranges).
While a band is null any positive lux passes and is reported as exploratory, so
the file validates but nothing is actually being checked on illuminance.
Fill in [low, high] per emotion as the ranges land, and leave null only for any
emotion you genuinely intend to keep unbounded.

lighting._comment: Confirmed warm white. I need a number in kelvin to build against: 2700K and 3000K look materially different against a cool wall. See my note about warm light interacting with the cool-hue conditions at low illuminance.

cells._example: Worked example from your 4a batch-2 calm/curved sample, with a saturation figure filled in for illustration. Replace with the aggregated value.

_field_notes.hue_detail: Free text, logged only, excluded from analysis, matching your template. Optional.
_field_notes.n_samples: How many samples this cell aggregates. Optional, but it goes straight into thesis section 3.3.
_field_notes.aggregation: How samples were collapsed: mode, mean, median, or a note. Optional.
_field_notes.consistency: Mode share for the discrete variables, or variance for the continuous ones. Optional.
_field_notes.brightness_lux: A single number in lux. calm and tense must sit inside the declared band; excited and depressed accept any positive value and are reported as exploratory.
